title: Renderflow operator-supplied speech time map v1
description: Explicit equal-rate millisecond translations from verified prepared speech into the recorded original-media clock. The mapping is an operator assertion, not native timestamp evidence or proof of synchronization accuracy.
$comment: Application validation also pins exact mapping bytes (1–262144 bytes), rejects duplicate keys and positional object arrays, binds all four identity digests to an opaque verified saved result, and requires prepared-media evidence. Strict input WAV is unsupported. Each interval must have positive duration and stay within the verified prepared WAV duration. Source and target intervals must be sorted and nonoverlapping; target end equals original_start_ms + transcript_end_ms - transcript_start_ms and must be <=359999999. Every entire cue must fit one interval (start >= interval start and end <= interval end); crossing, uncovered, split, clipped, rescaled, or dropped cues are refused. Adjacent interval boundaries are permitted. Unused gaps are permitted, so the mapping need not cover the entire audio. These cross-field and byte constraints are not proved by schema validation. Note text is an operator assertion and does not prove human review.
